metadata.question: Did the visible water extent in the North Crimean Canal in Ukraine decrease between June 3 and July 19, 2023?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about water extent changes in the North Crimean Canal between June 3 and July 19, 2023. This requires: 1. Strategy: Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat imagery to detect water bodies using NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) 2. Location: Need to define geometry for the North Crimean Canal in Ukraine 3. Dates: Compare June 3, 2023 vs July 19, 2023 4. Processing: Calculate water extent using NDWI thresholding 5. Validation: Check for data availability and valid pixels I'll use: - Sentinel-2 imagery for better resolution - NDWI = (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) with threshold > 0.0 for water - Cloud masking using QA60 band - Count water pixels to compare extent Potential issues: - Cloud cover could obscure the area - Canal might be very narrow, requiring good resolution - Need to ensure geometry covers the canal properly ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometry for North Crimean Canal in Ukraine const canalGeometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [33.8, 46.2], [34.2, 46.2], [34.2, 46.4], [33.8, 46.4], [33.8, 46.2] ]]); // Function to mask clouds in Sentinel-2 function maskS2Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate NDWI and water extent function calculateWaterExtent(image) { const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.0); return waterMask; } // Get June 3, 2023 data const juneCollection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(canalGeometry) .filterDate('2023-06-01', '2023-06-05') .map(maskS2Clouds) .map(calculateWaterExtent); // Get July 19, 2023 data const julyCollection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(canalGeometry) .filterDate('2023-07-17', '2023-07-21') .map(maskS2Clouds) .map(calculateWaterExtent); // Check collection sizes const juneSize = juneCollection.size().getInfo(); const julySize = julyCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June images: ${juneSize}, July images: ${julySize}`); if (juneSize === 0 || julySize === 0) { // Try Landsat as fallback const juneLandsat = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(canalGeometry) .filterDate('2023-06-01', '2023-06-05'); const julyLandsat = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(canalGeometry) .filterDate('2023-07-17', '2023-07-21'); const juneLandsatSize = juneLandsat.size().getInfo(); const julyLandsatSize = julyLandsat.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat fallback - June: ${juneLandsatSize}, July: ${julyLandsatSize}`); if (juneLandsatSize === 0 || julyLandsatSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } } // Get median composites const juneWater = juneCollection.median(); const julyWater = julyCollection.median(); // Count water pixels const juneStats = juneWater.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: canalGeometry, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const julyStats = julyWater.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: canalGeometry, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const juneWaterPixels = juneStats.NDWI || 0; const julyWaterPixels = julyStats.NDWI || 0; console.log(`June water pixels: ${juneWaterPixels}`); console.log(`July water pixels: ${julyWaterPixels}`); // Check for valid pixels if (juneWaterPixels === 0 || julyWaterPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate percentage change const changePercent = ((julyWaterPixels - juneWaterPixels) / juneWaterPixels * 100); console.log(`Water change: ${changePercent.toFixed(1)}%`); // Validate result if (isNaN(changePercent) || !isFinite(changePercent)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Determine answer based on decrease if (changePercent < 0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
